audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 4 say Lillia while the why-strings beside them say the opposite ('your sustain shrugs off her weak level-1 poke', 'Infinite Duress at 6 catches her for a clean kill'), and row 3 says Warwick while its why says the window is skill-based.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick] at 54.92% over 366 games, and the mirror audit reports rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 were corrected there. The page currently renders two different answers to who wins level 1.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 4 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings, leaving the chart consistent with both the packet and its own prose.

audit.why: The spike windows are right: levels 3-5 once Blood Hunt closes her kiting, level 6, first item, and late. Only the mechanics inside the level-6 spike were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Watch Out! Eep! is labelled '(E)' and treated as a dodge in spikes[1].text and the mid prose, and Infinite Duress is called a 'point-and-click fight starter' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late.
audit.why: Watch Out! Eep! is her W — an area nuke with heavy damage in the centre, 500 range, 14s at rank 1 — with no dodge or dash component anywhere in Riot's text. Her spacing tool is Swirlseed (E): 700 range, flat 12s, a rolling projectile that damages and slows. And Infinite Duress is a directional leap suppressing the first champion collided with for 1.5s, not point-and-click.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, Swirlseed named as the real bait target with its 12s cooldown, and R restated as a leap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Land Lilting Lullaby' (wants.foe[1]) and 'Your Eternal Hunger' (whys[0]) as probable wrong names.
audit.why: Both are false positives — Lilting Lullaby is Lillia's R, Eternal Hunger is Warwick's passive.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lillia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps and suppresses the first champion it collides with for 1.5s. Bait Swirlseed's slow (flat 12s), then leap — her sleep is delayed.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Lillia carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Infinite Duress ignores her Watch Out! (E) dodge attempts and her Lilting Lullaby (R) is a delayed sleep — pop her before she can zone, and your suppression locks her out of any spacing.
edits.after: Watch Out! Eep! (W) is an area nuke, not a dodge — her spacing is Swirlseed (E), a 700-range rolling slow on a flat 12s. Leap once it is spent and Blood Hunt keeps you glued to her.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay yours. Blood Hunt movement speed erases her kiting, and once you hit 6 Infinite Duress catches her through Watch Out! dodges for a guaranteed pickoff.
